activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock rallies 25% over two weeks. At the peak, a candle forms with a tiny real body and a lower shadow 3x the body height. Raju calls it a Hammer and buys immediately. What critical mistake did Raju make?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock rallies 25% over two weeks. At the peak, a candle forms with a tiny real body and a lower shadow 3x the body height. Raju calls it a Hammer and buys immediately. What critical mistake did Raju make?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: Raju ignored trend context: a small body with long lower shadow after an uptrend is a Hanging Man (bearish warning), not a Hammer (bullish bottom). Moreover, he failed to wait for next-day bearish confirmation before acting.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
